title: Injection: XSS, Verb/Parameter Tampering, SSI, Code/File Inclusion, Command, SSTI, Prototype Pollution, Unicode

tests.weakness: The search parameter is echoed without encoding into three distinct contexts: HTML body, an HTML attribute value and a JavaScript string literal, so each needs a different breakout payload.

tests.surface: POST :8500/guestbook (author=, comment=) then GET /guestbook; POST /profile (bio=) then GET /profile
tests.weakness: Guestbook comments and profile bios are persisted in SQLite and rendered unescaped to every later visitor; the bio also lands inside a JS string literal.
Admin access control is enforced only for GET and POST, so PUT/PATCH/HEAD and arbitrary verbs reach the protected handler; the nginx WAF rule likewise inspects only GET query strings.

nginx authorises on the first occurrence of role while the Flask handler takes the last; the transfer gateway validates the first body occurrence and forwards the raw body to an internal backend that takes the last.

tests.surface: GET :8505/cgi-bin/greet.cgi?name=<!--#exec cmd="id"--> then GET the returned /pages/*.shtml
tests.weakness: Apache mod_include with Options +Includes and AddOutputFilter INCLUDES .shtml; a CGI writes user input verbatim into a .shtml page, so injected SSI echo/exec directives are executed by the server.

PHP eval() and call_user_func() execute attacker-supplied code; include() has no path validation and allow_url_include=On, giving LFI, php://filter source disclosure, log poisoning and RFI against an in-range host.
A ping utility concatenates input into a shell command (subprocess shell=True and PHP shell_exec); a second lookup utility discards output, leaving a time-based blind channel.
User input is concatenated into the template source itself: Flask render_template_string (Jinja2) and Mako Template(). Both evaluate attacker expressions and reach OS command execution.

tests.surface: POST :8520/settings {"__proto__":{...}} then GET /admin, GET /profile, POST /render on new connections
tests.weakness: A hand-rolled recursive merge with no own-property guard writes into Object.prototype via __proto__ and constructor.prototype; later unrelated requests inherit isAdmin=true and ejs 3.1.6 picks up a polluted outputFunctionName for RCE.

Path blacklist, authorisation equality, SQL keyword filter and XSS filter all run before NFKC normalization / casefold, so fullwidth characters and U+017F long-s fold back into the blocked ASCII forms at the sink.
